production_model: Designed in-house, small runs, sold direct
notes: Homepage title: 'Modern Streetwear - mnml Wardrobe Essentials'.

HQ is not stated outright: the About page says the design team works in a 'downtown Los Angeles studio'. The jobs link names mnml Brands LLC, but the site doesn't say whether that is a parent company.
Shipping: 'All international orders are shipped via DHL'. CA/GB/AU appear in the country selector, but the policy doesn't list destinations, so only US is stored.
Collection pages render few products to WebFetch. The shop page showed a $88 cargo pant (not in the stored range). No size-guide page was found; the size range comes from the collection size filters.

2026-10-29: the old streetwear and denim price rows (truncated pages) were replaced by the jeans row from products.json. Regular price = no variant with compare_at_price above price and no sale/markdown tag; sale items excluded.
production_model detail: Styles engineered in-house; limited quantities with chosen production partners; sold direct to consumers (About page)
2026-10-29 (aelfric-eden run): hoodies XS–XXXL on all 69 regular-price hoodies; free shipping over $50 and 30-day returns confirmed on the refund policy page.
